parrafo_1.es: Revolution Pest Services es una empresa local en Lakeland. Jonathan atiende hormigas, cucarachas, termitas, avispas y arañas, tanto dentro como fuera de la casa.
parrafo_1.en: Revolution Pest Services is a local Lakeland business. Jonathan handles ants, roaches, termites, wasps and spiders, both inside and outside the home.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes destacan que explica el proceso con calma antes de empezar, responde rapido incluso para emergencias (como nidos descubiertos al remodelar), y toma en cuenta ninos, mascotas y huertos al elegir el tratamiento.
parrafo_2.en: Customers point to how calmly he explains the process before starting, how fast he responds even for emergencies like nests found during a remodel, and how he factors in kids, pets and vegetable gardens when choosing the treatment.

items.quote: Jonathan has been excellent and goes the extra mile. When my shower was being replaced and huge ant nests were discovered in the wall, he came immediately and treated the area. His prices are reasonable and he is trustworthy.

As a mom with lots of concern, I wholeheartedly recommend Revolution Pest Services. Jonathan took the time to explain what the process would look like, and was considerate of my concerns regarding the chemicals used, as I have vegetable gardens, chickens, dogs, and kids at home.

Jonathan was extremely knowledgeable, thorough and professional. Took the time to listen to our concerns and address everything. The service he provided was excellent! Would highly recommend to anyone looking for pest control.
